title: docs(qa): author the v18 line's capabilities into the platform checklist (48 since:v18 items)
body:
Fixes #23879
Clause-②: no

## What this does

The platform checklist carried no `since: "v18"` item, so `node scripts/checklist-select.mjs since:v18` resolved to nothing and a v18 release sweep re-ran only the P0 smoke. This PR authors **48 `since: "v18"` items across 14 area files** — QA data only, no package touched.

Premise re-measured before writing: on origin/main `94114c1f`, `since:v18 --json` returned `[]` (exit 1, "nothing matched"), and `.changeset/pre/` held 714 consumed changesets (29 major, 363 minor, 322 patch). On this head the same selector resolves **48 runnable items**.

### How the delta was enumerated

Six independent read-only passes (SWEEP.md method, scoped to the v18 delta rather than a whole-ledger re-sweep):

- four over the 392 major/minor changesets (about 150 capability rows, grouped);
- one over the 322 patch changesets (82 that add or change runner-observable behaviour; the other ~240 are fixes of existing behaviour or text);
- one over the ADR-0087 step-18 registries (`MAJOR_18_CONVERSIONS` 72, `RETIRED_KEYS_BY_MAJOR[18]` 239, `RETIRED_DEFS_BY_MAJOR[18]` 170, 389 `18.*` semantic entries) and the landed ADR-0131 stages.

Rows were grouped into one item per capability family (each item lists its contributing changesets in `source`). Every item carries its permanent pins in `automated.ref` plus live steps against a booted showcase. Every pin path and cited source file was checked to exist; all 87 new symbol anchors resolve (`symbol anchors: 822/832`, the 10 being the existing named residual).

| area | new items |
|---|---|
| access-security | 9 |
| identity-auth | 5 |
| automation · cli | 5 each |
| api-backend · platform-core · records-forms | 4 each |
| studio-authoring | 3 |
| approvals · attachments-storage · integration-system | 2 each |
| ai · dashboards · i18n | 1 each |

P0: `identity-auth.default-organization-boot-invariant`, `access-security.walled-environment-metadata-operator-only`, `platform-core.v18-boot-refusals`, `cli.organization-ownership-ceremony` (the 17 → 18 upgrade end to end — nothing in the ledger exercised it before).

### No item — pure retirements already pinned

A retirement is refused at parse with its tombstone, so its honest answer is the pin, not an item:

- element flat data-binding keys: `packages/spec/src/ui/element-flat-binding-retirement.test.ts`
- manifest `permissions` string list: `packages/spec/src/kernel/manifest-permissions-string-list.test.ts`
- the four catalog row objects: `packages/qa/dogfood/test/wall-catalog-refusal.dogfood.test.ts`
- `sys_view_definition`: `packages/metadata-protocol/src/plugin.metadata-objects-retired.test.ts`
- `sys_approval_token` generic door: `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/sys-approval-token-generic-door.integration.test.ts`
- email template `category` / `isSystem`: `packages/spec/src/system/email-template-category-is-system-retirement.test.ts`
- view `provider: 'api'`: `packages/spec/src/ui/view-data-api-provider-retirement.test.ts`
- document-family schemas: `packages/spec/src/data/document-schemas-retirement.test.ts`
- `allowOrgOverride` → `allowEnvironmentOverlay`: `packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-type-registry-allow-org-override-retirement.test.ts`
- legacy `OBJECTSTACK_METADATA_WRITABLE`: `packages/rest/src/rest-meta-managed-seal-hatch.test.ts`
- storage scope `public` (also asserted live in `attachments-storage.upload-limits-scope-and-ownership`): `packages/services/service-storage/src/upload-scope-vocabulary.test.ts`
- `sys_comment.reactions` column (also live in `records-forms.comment-reactions-and-edit-stamps`): `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/sys-comment-reactions-door.integration.test.ts`
- `externalSharingModel`, guest recipient, the i18n plugin's own routes, bare `unique: true` on an index, and the 23421 / 23487 / 23488 / 23543 retirements: pins listed per row in the dev report on #23879.

The rest of the 72 step-18 conversions are covered generically by `api-backend.enforce-or-remove-authoring-gates` / `api-backend.retired-def-refusal` and the fixture replay in `packages/spec/src/conversions/conversions.test.ts`.

## Run — `checklist-test since:v18` on this branch

Subject: framework `94114c1f` (the code is origin/main; this branch changes ledger data only), fresh showcase boot on its own port and ephemeral DB, `Tenancy: single`. Run sequentially by one runner; the per-item verdict table is in the dev report on #23879, and the seat files the `qa-run` record and the defect cards from it.

- **Tier 1 — every pin in `automated.ref`, 228 files across 32 packages: all pass** (e.g. spec 24 files / 1546 tests, runtime 34 / 590, rest 20 / 802, objectql 23 / 402, qa/dogfood 15 / 181, cli 25 / 330 plus its one `*.e2e.test.ts`, which packages/cli collects only under `OS_TEST_TIERS=nightly` and which passes there, 2 tests).
- **Tier 2 — live API legs**: 1 item PASS, 45 PARTIAL (pins pass, live legs not all driven, or walled / scratch-app / console legs not provisioned this round), **2 FAIL**:
  - `access-security.anonymous-floor-v18-doors` — anonymous `GET /api/v1/keys` answers 405, not the 401 the 23225 contract states (twice, fresh calls).
  - `access-security.grant-table-write-contract` — an inverted validity window is refused as an unevaluable predicate (`Unknown variable: previous`), never with the `validity_window_order` rule's own message (twice).
- **Console legs: blocked(environment).** `pnpm objectui:build` fails at the pinned `.objectui-sha` `daeb77fc`: `[MISSING_EXPORT] "checkPageComponentViewData" is not exported by packages/spec/dist/ui/index.mjs` — the export was deleted in a35f7a67 (#23784) while the pinned objectui still imports it.

The first live pass also disproved four things in my own first draft of the items; those were corrected before any record pinned their revision (a view name is dotted `OBJECT.NAME`; the `/meta` version token is served only on the `?state=draft` read; stock self-registration is closed, so the member is created by the admin and lands held; the dispatcher `/ui` domain is not mounted over HonoServer).

## Gates

Local, on head `2d410efa`, from `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (exit codes captured before any pipe): all 13 exit 0 — `check-ci-filter-parity`, `check-closing-keyword-parity` (+ `--self-test`), `check-comment-mask-corpus`, `check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:driver-memory-census`, `check:gitlink-declared`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:platform-checklist`, `check:refd-timer-probe`, `check:watch-hint-literal`. `--ran` reconciliation: 13 derived, 13 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a derived zero).

**Changeset:** none — `docs/qa/**` sits outside every package's published `files`, so nothing publishes (`skip-changeset`).

**Size:** 3,532 changed lines (all additions, all JSON), over the 3,000-line threshold, so this lands by an authorized review or a human merge, not the queue on green alone.

## Acceptance notes

- **Stale existing items — not edited here** (#23878 is running the existing items at the same time, and a revision bump mid-run would orphan its pinned revisions). Each contradicts v18 behaviour:
  - `cli.migrate-meta-codemod` — still asserts that no `--write` exists (it ships, `packages/cli/test/migrate-meta-write.test.ts`), and still names protocol major 17;
  - `access-security.capability-declaration-lifecycle` — "bootstraps into sys_capability" (retired);
  - `automation.trigger-type-matrix`, `automation.time-relative-trigger`, `platform-core.notification-center` — assume scheduled work fires on a stock boot; on v18 it is off unless `OS_AUTOMATION_SCHEDULED_WORK_ENABLED=true` (this run's boot log says so);
  - `attachments-storage.attach-requires-parent-edit` — an outsider who cannot read the parent now gets 404 `RECORD_NOT_FOUND`, not 403;
  - `approvals.approver-resolution-matrix` — `admin_rescue` now opens on the org administrators;
  - `records-forms.validation-rule-type-matrix` — warning hits now come back in `warnings[]`;
  - `cli.scaffold-first-run` — skills now sync from `@objectstack/skills`;
  - `automation.trigger-type-matrix` also defers the body-only hook refusal that has since landed;
  - `platform-core.shell-nav-personalization` — drag reorder of the app menu was removed (probably stale; not checked against its steps);
  - `api-backend.date-range-preset-matrix` — rolling presets now end on today.
- **Readings carried from the seat post, verified, not touched** (my edits do not reach those items): `records-forms.concurrent-edit-conflict` cites `packages/rest/src/approvals-routes.ts#mapping` for `CONCURRENT_UPDATE` → 409, but that map has no `CONCURRENT_UPDATE` row (the mapping lives in `rest-server.ts`); `access-security`'s record-shares source text says the family is "registered inline, under no registrar of its own", while `packages/rest/src/sharing-routes.ts` documents and serves it under `RestServer#registerSharingEndpoints`.
- ADR-0131 C8 has not landed: `SqlDriver` `applyTenantScope` still carries `.orWhereNull(field)`. The ADR puts that removal on the v18 line after C7, which has landed.
- `POST /api/v1/keys` drops an unrecognised body key without a word (a camelCase `expiresAt` 400 days out mints a 90-day key and answers 201); the response echoes the real `expires_at`, and the drop is in the safe direction.
- Pins by registry id: 12 of the 72 step-18 conversions and 297 of the 389 `18.*` semantic entries are named by no test (excluding the 169-id guidance roster); two retirements have no pin found at all (the discard-overlay route, `os meta resync`).

Not in this PR: running the existing items (#23878); fixing what the run found (one card each, filed by the seat from the dev report).
